calls.title: FlowGPT Sync
calls.summary: The team is strategizing to retain a significant AI customer by transitioning them from a $150k Statsig contract to a more cost-effective Growth Book deal valued at $80-90k. This involves offering bundled features like experimentation tools and governance capabilities that address the customer’s reliance on internal AI workflows for analysis. The customer uses an on-premise StarRocks data warehouse, necessitating the development of a custom connector to facilitate integration. Growth Book aims to stand out in the competitive market by becoming a backbone for AI-driven experimentation, emphasizing the importance of governance and improved efficiency in analysis. A follow-up call with the client is planned to gather insights and prepare for the upcoming contract renewal, ensuring that Growth Book remains a competitive option.
calls.keywords: AI experimentation, feature flagging, data warehouse integration, assignment logic, customer workflow, contract negotiation
